issues.title: Spec does not say whether folder grants inherit
issues.explanation: The code walks up the tree and allows the action if any ancestor folder grants a high enough role. ACL-31 only says grants are stored per resource. Whether a folder grant applies to everything inside it, and whether a lower grant on a child can restrict it, is a product decision the reviewer cannot judge from the ticket.
issues.fix: Ask the ticket owner whether grants inherit down the tree and whether child grants can override; then keep or remove the ancestor walk.
